newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS starts coverage of Micrion.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS starts coverage of Micrion.

text.p: -- UBS Securities analyst Mark FitzGerald initiated coverage of Micrion Corp with a buy rating and set earnings estimates for the fiscal year ending June 1997 of $0.88 per share and fiscal 1998 of $1.50 per share.
-- Micrion is the top supplier of focused ion beam systems, an emerging technology used to alter and analyze materials at the submicron level.
-- The business is expected to grow about 30 percent a year, the analyst said in published comments.
